sentences.text: 2  NC: 2024:KHC-D:3645  WP No. 102677 of 2022 ANNEXURE-H AND RESTORE THE NAME OF PETITIONERS AND TO ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS TO THE 1ST RESPONDENT TO PASS AN AWARD AND PAY THE COMPENSATION TO THE PETITIONERS COMMERCIAL SITE BEARING NO. 55/1B MEASURING 2 GUNTAS 15 ANNAS SITUATED AT AMARGOL HUBBALLI TALUK

WITH ALL CONSEQUENTIAL STATUTORY BENEFITS  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
The petitioner No.1 and his brother jointly purchased Block No.55 measuring 22 guntas 2 annas situated at Amargol, Taluk Hubli through a registered sale dated 24.9.2009.
In the master plan published by the Hubli-Darwad Urban Development Authority, the subject property is designated for commercial purpose.
The petitioner obtained a building permission from the respondent No.3 on 30.11.2010.
The extent of 2 guntas 15 anas is acquired for the purpose of BRTS project.

However,
the petitioners have been denied compensation stating that, the property acquired is designated for road in the master plan published by the Hubli-Dharwad Urban Development Authority.
2. The contention of the respondent No.2 is that, the petitioners are not the owners of the acquired land.
The respondent No.2 submits that the name of one Adrushappa Desai is mutated in the revenue records, and the notification was issued in the name of the said person.
Therefore, the petitioners, who have no right over the acquired land, cannot maintain this petition.
A perusal of the sale deed dated 24.9.2009 indicated that, the petitioner No.1 along with Sri Adrushapa Desai purchased an extent of 22 guntas 2.25 anas in Block No.55/1.
In pursuance of the sale deed, the names of petitioner No.1 and his brother were mutated in the revenue record.

Therefore, the sale deed, and the record of right clearly indicated that, the petitioner No.1 along with his brother were the absolute owners of the acquired property, and in the family partition effected between petitioner No.1 and his brother.
The acquired land is allotted to the share of petitioners herein.
Therefore, the petitioners have locus standai to maintain this petition.

4. The issue as to whether the properties earmarked for widening of national highway in the master plan published by the Planning Authority under the provisions of Karnataka Urban Development Authority Act, and the Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, falls under the purview of Section 32(5) of the Karnataka Urban Development Authority Act was examined by the coordinate Bench of this Court in WP No.108208/2016 and connected petitions, and the coordinate Bench of this Court by order dated 22.12.2021 held that the properties designated for road as margin area in Shashikumar S/O Vasanna Desai vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61349303/
3 the Master Plan does not fall under the purview of Section 32(5) of the Karnataka Urban Development Authority Act, and the decision of the coordinate Bench of this Court has been upheld by the Division Bench of this Court in WA No.100266/2022 and connected matters.

sentences.text: Therefore, this petition also requires to be NC: 2024:KHC-D:3645 disposed of in light of the order passed by the coordinate Bench of this Court as well as the Division Bench of this Court.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The petition is allowed.
ii) The impugned endorsement dated 07.03.2022 issued by the respondent No.1 at Annexure-F, and the award dated 12.2.2015 passed by the respondent No.1 at Annexure-G insofar as it relates to Sy.No.55/1B situated at Amargol, Taluk Hubli are hereby quashed.
iii) Respondent No.1 is hereby directed to pass an award, and pay compensation to petitioners in accordance with law after notifying the petitioners within a period of six months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
iv) The respondent No.5 is hereby directed to delete the name of the respondent No.3-Hubli-Dharwad Municipal Corporation from the revenue records to an extent of 2 guntas out of 5 guntas, which is shown as road margin area in the master plan published by the respondent No.4-Hubli-Dharwd Urban Development Authority.
Sd/-
